charges_value_check.name: charges_value_check
charges_value_check.value:
("charges"."kind" = 'percent' AND coalesce("charges"."cargo_value", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND coalesce("charges"."passenger_value", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)
        OR ("charges"."kind" = 'fixed' AND coalesce("charges"."cargo_value", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 AND coalesce("charges"."passenger_value", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)

manifests_cargo_type_check.name: manifests_cargo_type_check
manifests_cargo_type_check.value:
"manifests"."category" = 'cargo' AND "manifests"."cargo_type" IN ('fuel', 'liquids', 'containers', 'general_cargo')
        OR "manifests"."category" = 'passenger' AND "manifests"."cargo_type" IS NULL AND "manifests"."cargo_unit" = 'seat'

roles_govt_check.name: roles_govt_check
roles_govt_check.value: "roles"."company_id" IS NOT NULL OR "roles"."key" IS NOT NULL

users_company_check.name: users_company_check
users_company_check.value: ("users"."kind" = 'company') = ("users"."company_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("users"."kind" = 'company' OR "users"."branch_id" IS NULL)
